PROCEDURE GATES IS
V_RG_ID RECORDGROUP;
V_STR VARCHAR2(1000);
BEGIN

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_GATE_NBR
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION GET_GATE_NBR RETURN NUMBER IS
 HFILE TEXT_IO.FILE_TYPE;
 V_FILENAME VARCHAR2(2000);
 V_LINE VARCHAR2(2000);
 V_GATE_NBR NUMBER;
BEGIN
 BEGIN
 SELECT VAR_VALUE
 INTO V_FILENAME
 FROM SC_PORT_SETTING
 WHERE SYSOBJ_ID = 999
 AND VAR_NAME = 'GATE_FILENAME'
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 RETURN(NULL);
 END;

 BEGIN
 HFILE := TEXT_IO.FOPEN(V_FILENAME,'R');
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 RETURN(NULL);
 END;

 BEGIN
 TEXT_IO.GET_LINE(HFILE, V_LINE);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 TEXT_IO.FCLOSE(HFILE);
 RETURN(NULL);
 END;

 TEXT_IO.FCLOSE(HFILE);
 V_GATE_NBR := TO_NUMBER(V_LINE);
 RETURN(V_GATE_NBR);

EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 RETURN(NULL);
END;
